siem.note: Wazuh / Falco / CrowdSec alert summaries from intake_platform.siem.feed.load_console_feed (INT-205), counted by signal and severity. The feed returns not-configured (None) until the alert stream is mounted, so the console shows that state rather than a 0 — 'nothing detected' and 'never wired up' must not look the same (invariant 17). Signals and severities are sealed to the platform's own enums, and every alert carries ids, not narrative (invariant 6).

egress_denials.note: Denied egress attempts from the PHI path (sec.egress_denied_total, INT-018; invariants 14/19), summed over the last 24h. The allow-list is default-deny and the PHI path reaches no external model or speech vendor at all; the catalogue target is 0 and any increase pages. Read from the metrics scrape at serve time — without one the tile is source-unavailable, never a bare 0 (invariant 17).

audit_chain.reason: no externally anchored head is published (HB-I12), so nothing independent can attest the chain: a self-consistent chain survives both a truncation and a full re-forge, and reporting it intact would be a pass by omission (files/10 §2)
audit_chain.note: Daily audit hash-chain verification (sec.audit_chain_ok, INT-016; invariant 4). 1 means verified against the EXTERNALLY ANCHORED head, never merely that the store agrees with itself — a truncation and a full re-forge both survive a self-check (files/10 §2). HB-I12 is open (no anchor publisher exists), so the verdict is anchor_missing, fail-closed. The console carries no chain hash and reads no chain: the head is published outside the platform_admin blast radius, and this surface sits inside it.

pentest.note: Pen-test findings tracked to closure against the vulnerability SLA (files/10 §7, §9; sec.vulns_open / sec.vuln_age_days). The first external pen-test is before the P2 pilot, so no assessment is recorded and the list is genuinely empty (invariant 17); the SLA (critical 72 h / high 7 d / medium 30 d) is the clock a future finding is judged against. Findings carry ids and status, never a finding's prose (invariant 6).
